title: Kenny Bravo keeps it real with catchy hip-hop anthem "Real Trap Nigga"
htmlContent: Kenny Bravo, a Texas artist, has a new single, "Real Trap Nigga" which is an unfiltered and honest track. It's a track that introduces you to an unapologetic voice that speaks its absolute truth. https://open.spotify.com/track/4p4rI5XV4AtESwcvXkJWBY There's a crusty, street-born honesty running through "Real Trap Nigga" that makes the record hit harder. This one shows Kenny's hunger to be heard, and more importantly, his desire to distinguish himself without exception. And he invites you into his world, a realm of hustle and determination grounded in authenticity. On "Real Trap Nigga," Kenny Bravo establishes himself as an artist who has some real shit to communicate and the motivation to continue communicating it until the world hears him. It's brash, it's uncut, and it's precisely the statement an independent artist needs to make breaking in. Follow Kenny Bravo on Instagram
